dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Not here yet, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you waiting for?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: To tell you the truth, I'm not sure either.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: It might be those who left the village to buy some daily essentials, and it might also be the goods that our Eremite friends are sending over.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Who knows? We might even receive guests from Shamaniyya.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Alright, alright. In truth, my role is that of a lookout. I warn people of hazards that arise from the desert.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: That said, though, the desert around Aaru Village is a place of relative quiet, so what I usually end up reporting is the arrival of goods from outside the village.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: But thanks to that, I also get to hang out and chat with those who often travel outside, you know, maybe ask them to get me some seeds or a pot of flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: See you. Be wary of any changes in the environment when you are out in the desert!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fond of planting flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Well, uh, I... I just like having some to send to my girlfriend, you get what I mean?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: She's never been the healthy sort, so she's always at home resting and can't come out often... But she always looks way better when she has some plants for company.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: I mean, Aaru Village is as you see it... It's no haven for plants that need water.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Many times, those flowers that do get sent over don't live long even when given a lot of loving care.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: That's why I ask my fellow workers to get some of that stuff whenever I get the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Dear, why did you sneak outside again?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, don't worry! The night's not quite as hot, so it's perfect for getting some fresh air outside.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: The night is much cooler than the day, which makes it all the more reason to take better care of your health. Besides, you should stay where there's more greenery...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Yes, I know, I know. I just need to get out sometimes, you know? Just sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Look at you! You're so young, but already sound like my folks.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Wh—What? ...I mean, anyone who cares about you would say that! ...Ahem, anyway. How's the pot of flowers I gave you?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Um, yes, thanks for sending me the flowers. They are very beautiful. But the leaves are starting to turn yellow...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Sorry for not taking good care of them...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: N—No, don't apologize! It's fine, it's not your fault!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sha-what-yya?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Oh? Are you interested?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: According to legend, they are a group of people who dwell in the depths of the desert.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Some say that they were not on good terms with the Akademiya, and thus fled deep into the desert to avoid them.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Others say that they are an investigation team sent into the desert by the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: As for the details, I'm not very sure, but it's all hearsay. No one has ever seen them.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: But between you and me, I do hope that this legend is in fact real. It would be nice to see them and hear their tales from far away someday, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fond of planting flowers?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Well, uh, I... I just like having some to send to my girlfriend, you get what I mean?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: She wasn't well previously and is still resting at home even now, so she rarely goes out. But she really does love flowers — she looks much better whenever she is around them.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: I mean, Aaru Village is as you see it... It's no haven for plants that need water.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Many times, those flowers that do get sent over to me don't live long even when given a lot of loving care.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: That's why I ask my colleagues to get some of that stuff whenever I get the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Dear, why did you sneak outside again?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, don't worry! The night's not quite as hot, so it's perfect for getting some fresh air outside.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: But isn't the difference in temperatures between night and day precisely the reason you need to take care of yourself? You've only just recovered... You should spend a bit more time resting...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Yes, I know, I know. I just need to get out sometimes, you know? Just sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: And well, look at you! You're still a young man, but you already sound as old as my folks.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Wh—What? ...I mean, anyone who cares about you would say that! ...Ahem, anyway. How's the pot of flowers I gave you?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Um, yes, thanks for sending me the flowers. They are very lovely. But the leaves are starting to turn yellow...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Sorry, I haven't been taking good care of them...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: N—No, don't apologize! It's fine, it's not your fault!

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Agh, there's just no time at all...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: And no one will swap shifts with me, either. What do I do now...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Eh? Traveler? Um... Traveler, please hold on a moment!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: I'm sorry for taking up your time, but I'd like to ask you if you're free... and if you could do me a favor...

choices.text: Well, let's hear your story, then...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: You'd help me! Thank you! Thank you so much!

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Here's the situation: I ordered a flower pot from Azalai's shop, alongside a batch of seeds.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Originally, I had asked a friend to help me get them...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: But he suddenly told me that he had a mission to attend to and wouldn't have time to help me out. There was too little time for me to find someone else...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: So Traveler, could you please help me collect my purchases from Azalai's? I hear that he should be at the entrance to the village right now, waiting for goods to come in.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What did you buy all this stuff for, anyway?

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: She's in poor health, so she's been convalescing at home.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: I mean, you've seen it too. Aaru Village is in the middle of the desert, so there's not much greenery to go around. Can't say this is the best environment, can you?

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: So I bought some plants to place in her house, but always staying in her room has kept her in a bad mood.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: I'm also very busy at work, so I basically can't go to see her in the day. We only have time to talk to each other at night...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: That's why I thought that perhaps I could get her to raise some flowers herself, if only just to help pass the time and take her mind off her illness.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: I didn't expect things to get complicated like this...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Thank you so much! Just bring them straight back to me once you get them.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: I need to sow those seeds, loosen the soil, apply some fertilizer...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: But Nermin's constitution isn't that great. Will all this work just tire her out...?

choices.text: If you've got the pay, I've got the time.

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: Eh? Well... I do have some savings, so you don't have to worry about that...

response.speaker: Raef
response.text: But either way, thank you so much for agreeing to help.
